sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 1814 of 2022

Applicant :- Rahul Kumar Mishra
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Hemant Kumar Mishra,Ajay Kumar,Ajeet Kumar,Arti Ganguly,Pramod 
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Jay Prakash Singh
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Smt. Usha Tiwari, the learned counsel for the applicant and Shri Abhishek Kumar Singh,
learned AGA for the State.
2. By means of the instant application, the applicant is seeking bail in Case Crime No.615 of 2021 under Sections 406, 420, 504 IPC at police station- Kotwali Nagar District-Faizabad.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 21.09.2021 against five persons, including the applicant and his family members, stating that from the allurement of the applicant, the informant had made an investment in business in collaboration with the applicant.

He was paid bonus for a few months and thereafter he was given an allurement to join service in the company of accused persons " Ma Media House" and to bring investment to other persons for the company.
Under this allurement the complainant got a total of Rs. 62,50,000/- invested from his relative and friends.
Rs. 3,50,000/- were transferred to the bank account of co-accused Shyam Ji Rahul Kumar Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Shyam Ji Rahul Kumar Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120039366/
1 Mishra but no amount was returned.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the application, it has been stated that the applicant is involved in nine other cases of the similar nature and the learned counsel for the petitioner states that he has been granted bail in all of those cases.
5. Co-accused Shyam Ji Mishra, who is applicant's father, has been granted bail by means of order dated 02.11.2023 passed in bail application no. 6577 of 2022.
6. The applicant is languishing in jail since 22.09.2021 and as per the statement of the learned counsel for the applicant, even the charges have not been framed till date.
7. Learned AGA vehemently opposes the bail prayer of the applicant but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.
8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to released on bail.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
